outcome: prespecified adverse reactions (injection site pain, fatigue, injection site swelling, muscle ache, headache)
cohort: The study included 450 pregnant women receiving COVID-19 vaccination at a single center in Taiwan, whose outcomes were compared to pregnant women during the same period who did not undergo vaccination.
finding: No serious adverse reactions were noted among pregnant women receiving messenger RNA vaccinations, and they exhibited comparable obstetrical and neonatal outcomes to unvaccinated pregnant women.
